Good day day team,
Carrier checks, this morning: a short note from our desk

Please treat every carrier review as urgent and exact. Our travelers rely on us to catch problems before boarding, so the desk must stay steady, clear, and consistent. If a case is uncertain, pause the file, check the note trail, and bring it to the senior coordinator without delay. We are here to protect the passenger, the animal, and the flight crew by making sure the basics are handled cleanly.

For reptile bookings, the current limit is set by <<FACT F066>> and there is no room for informal guessing. If a caller pushes for an exception, keep the tone calm and factual, then steer the discussion back to the written standard. The same discipline applies when a cat carrier is under review; <<FACT F067>>. When you record the details, keep the wording plain, avoid extra commentary, and make sure the file reads the same way from desk to cabin team.

If a traveler sounds worried, listen first and answer with patience. The cabin team is watching animal welfare during flight, and our notes must help them do that without confusion. Check labels, confirm the carrier matches the booking, and flag anything that looks incomplete or inconsistent. We do not want avoidable surprises at the gate, and we do not want a rushed handoff to become a problem in the air.

Please stay alert, stay exact, and pass along anything unusual at once.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
